svg.title: Multiple shooting in Corleone.jl
svg.desc: A ShootingLayer maps parameters ps and state st to a trajectory. The horizon from t0 to t5 is split into five segments. The control p(t) is piecewise constant and switches at every grid time. The state x(t) is integrated segment by segment; at t2 it is reset to a tunable shooting value x-tilde-2, which leaves a jump with residual r2 = x-tilde-2 minus x(t2-). The trajectory feeds the objective, constraints, and residuals; SciMLSensitivity.jl differentiates them; Optimization.jl updates ps, closing the loop.
